map.输入存货余额与年营业成本，求存货周转天数。: Compute days inventory outstanding from inventory balance and annual cost of goods sold to optimize stock management.
map.DIO = 存货 / 营业成本 × 365: DIO = Inventory / Cost of Goods Sold × 365
map.DIO = 存货/营业成本 × 365: DIO = Inventory / Cost of Goods Sold × 365
map.DIO 越短变现越快。: The shorter the DIO, the faster inventory is converted to cash.
map.衡量存货从入库到售出平均占用多少天，评估库存效率。: Measures the average days inventory is held from receipt to sale to assess stock efficiency.
map.季节性行业备货时，测算存货天数避免积压或断货。: For seasonal stockpiling, estimate inventory days to avoid overstock or stockouts.
map.对比同业，识别自身供应链管理优劣。: Compare with peers to identify strengths and weaknesses in supply-chain management.
map.某公司期末存货 300 万元，年度营业成本 3600 万元，存货天数=300÷(: A company has ending inventory of 300 (10k CNY) and annual cost of goods sold of 3600 (10k CNY), so inventory days = 300 ÷ (3600/365) = 300 ÷ 9.863 ≈ 30.4 days, meaning inventory turns over about every 30 days.
map.存货天数越短越好吗？: Is a shorter inventory days always better?
map.通常越短资金占用越少、跌价风险越低，但过短可能频繁断货、丧失销售；需结合安全库存: Usually the shorter, the less capital tied up and the lower the risk of price declines, but too short can mean frequent stockouts and lost sales; balance it against safety stock and the replenishment cycle.
map.用营业成本还是营业收入？: Use cost of goods sold or revenue?
map.存货对应已售商品的成本，故用营业成本（COGS）更匹配；用收入会混入毛利，高估周: Inventory corresponds to the cost of goods sold, so using cost of goods sold (COGS) matches better; using revenue would mix in gross profit and overstate turnover efficiency.
